q: What is the carbon footprint of geotextile fabric per square metre?
title: Geotextile per square metre
short: Woven and non-woven geotextiles are mostly polypropylene or polyester, so the polymer is the main share. Extrusion, needle punching or weaving add electricity. Multiply grams per square metre by a polymer factor, then add process energy from the supplier.
audience: Geotextile makers and road and rail contractors

ul: Polymer: PP or polyester, by grams per square metre.

p: A figure per square metre at the stated GSM lets contractors compare products fairly.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
